title: Jude and the Wolf Again
author: Mara Thackeray
blurb: Cyrus Ishikawa, a bone-carver who hears the dead, keeps the ledgers of a guild that trades in impossible things. But when a dying stranger presses a map into unwilling hands, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must find the door out of a country that no longer exists, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
